rubric.item: locked edit e2e/settings.spec.ts limited to re-pin + two comments (Q-2)

findings.issue: The late-success close in opened() (`if (blocked) { db.close(); return; }`) is not actually exercised by any assertion. Spec section 7 says SPEC-03 covers it indirectly because the retry would be blocked by a stray connection, but the retry opens at the same version (5), which never fires versionchange/blocked, and without the early return the stray connection would still get the onversionchange close handler.
findings.evidence: Removing lines 77-81 of src/storage/hand-store.ts leaves SPEC-03 passing: the stray v5 connection does not block a same-version open, and openRaw(factory, DB_VERSION) at test line 64 is also same-version.
findings.fix: Optional: in the retry test, after the first (rejected) open has completed, check the stray connection is closed, e.g. open at DB_VERSION + 1 with a raw connection after closing the store's own connection via its versionchange, or accept the gap and correct the spec's edge-case note. Not a SPEC item, so no change is required.

findings.issue: `db === opening` in the catch handler is always true: db is only replaced after it has been set to null, and only this handler sets it to null.
findings.evidence: database() assigns db only when db === null; the sole reset is this catch.
findings.fix: Drop `&& db === opening`, or keep it as a cheap guard if preferred.

findings.issue: The edited openHandStore docblock line is about 170 characters, well over the file's ~120-column comment width (Prettier does not rewrap comments).
findings.evidence: ` * error, except that a blocked open (UpgradeBlockedError) is retried on the next call. Records are validated by parseHandRecord / ...`
findings.fix: Rewrap the docblock to the surrounding width.

summary: All eight SPEC items are implemented as specified and their tests would fail on a broken implementation: SPEC-01 now asserts the raw settings record; SPEC-02 would hang/time out without onblocked; SPEC-03 fails if the cached rejection is not cleared; SPEC-05/06/08 fail with the old DOM order or without order:-1. The locked e2e/settings.spec.ts edit is exactly the expect re-pin and the two wrap comments. Unit (5/5) and e2e back-focus + settings (12/12, chromium + webkit) pass locally. No BLOCKER or MAJOR findings; one MINOR (late-success close is untested despite the spec's indirect-coverage claim) and two NITs.
